t: Polycell Trade Polyfilla One Fill Tub is a ready to use, lightweight filler designed for efficiently filling gaps and cracks. This versatile white filler is ideal for professional decorators and builders tackling both interior and exterior projects. Its smooth finish means no sanding is required, significantly reducing preparation time. The quick-drying formula allows for painting over in just 15 minutes, ensuring rapid project completion. With no sag performance and no depth limit, this Polyfilla is suitable for a variety of applications on walls and ceilings, providing a durable repair.
